paragrafe: A design company doesn't need more hands — it needs someone who can execute cleanly at production volume without the standard dropping as the deadline closes in.

I've solved that at scale. At Yokogawa Europe I built a repository of 200+ unified graphic templates across 12 countries, cutting visual production cycles by 30%. For Microsoft, Nikon and Veeam I produced 25,000+ product visuals that stayed on-brand in every market. At Smite I ran campaigns end-to-end — from online promotion to business cards, banners, posters and in-store material.

I don't avoid the AI question — I build on it. Over the past four years I've structured AI-augmented production pipelines with Comfy UI, Adobe Firefly and prompt engineering built on harness and JSON scripting. The output ships faster and the craft still holds.
My background is economic, so I optimise against outcomes, not preferences. Send me the brief and I'll tell you exactly where design is the bottleneck.
